items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: The first concert was given by Freddie Johnson, Billy Taylor, Pete du Conge, and Arthur Briggs.

ctx.x: Yes, he was from New Orleans, right, yes, yes. Well, I'm going to tell you about him. Now, I tell you that Bricktop hired us all, right, and Peter was her husband, he was a member of the orchestra, naturally.
And there was Freddie Johnson, Arthur Briggs, Billy Taylor, and I can't remember who was on bass now -- Herb Fleming --
